label: Build SDLC Orchestrator
info: This flow visually ports the Go-based build router. It polls every 5 seconds, implements strict serialization (locking), executes agents via CLI, runs workspace tests, and performs git sweeps.

name: Check & Set Lock
Parse Config

command: sqlite3 -json .build/build.db "SELECT id, status FROM tasks WHERE status = 'failed' LIMIT 1"
name: Check Blocked Tasks
Evaluate Blocked

command: sqlite3 -json .build/build.db "SELECT id, title, description, status FROM tasks WHERE status = 'stuck' LIMIT 1"
name: Check Stuck Tasks
Evaluate Stuck

command: sqlite3 -json .build/build.db "SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.agent_id FROM tasks t WHERE t.status = 'todo' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks c WHERE c.parent_id = t.id AND c.status = 'todo' ) ORDER BY t.rowid ASC LIMIT 1"
name: Get Next Todo
Evaluate Todo
Check DB Assignment
Prep DB Assignment
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 .build/build.db \"UPDATE tasks SET agent_id = 2 WHERE id = '" + msg.task.id + "'; INSERT INTO audit_logs (task_id, actor_id, action, llm_provider, llm_model, opencode_agent) VALUES ('" + msg.task.id + "', 1, 'assign_to_dev', '" + msg.adapter + "', '', 'build');\"";
return msg;

name: Prep Comments Query
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 -json .build/build.db \"SELECT a.role, c.content FROM comments c JOIN agents a ON c.agent_id = a.id WHERE c.task_id = '" + msg.task.id + "' ORDER BY c.id ASC\"";
return msg;

name: Parse Comments
Prep Template File
Format Prompt
Prep Sweep
func:
msg.payload = 'agent ' + msg.adapter + ' < cmd/build/templates/sweep.md';
return msg;

name: Check Git changes
Prep Dev Transition
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 .build/build.db \"UPDATE tasks SET agent_id = 3 WHERE id = '" + msg.task.id + "'; INSERT INTO audit_logs (task_id, actor_id, action, llm_provider, llm_model, opencode_agent) VALUES ('" + msg.task.id + "', 1, 'assign_to_tester', '" + msg.adapter + "', '', 'build');\"";
return msg;

name: Prep Tester Pass
Prep Tester Fail
Eval Tester Escalation
Prep Boss Comment Query
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 -json .build/build.db \"SELECT content FROM comments WHERE task_id = '" + msg.task.id + "' AND agent_id = 4 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\"";
return msg;

name: Evaluate Boss Decision
Prep Boss Approve
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 .build/build.db \"UPDATE tasks SET status = 'done' WHERE id = '" + msg.task.id + "'; INSERT INTO audit_logs (task_id, actor_id, action, llm_provider, llm_model, opencode_agent) VALUES ('" + msg.task.id + "', 1, 'task_approved', '" + msg.adapter + "', '', 'build');\"";
return msg;

name: Prep Boss Reject
Eval Boss Escalation
Prep Boss Format Error
Eval Format Error Escalation
Prep Lead Transition
func:
msg.payload = "sqlite3 -json .build/build.db \"SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM comments WHERE task_id = '" + msg.task.id + "' AND agent_id = 5\"";
return msg;

name: Eval Lead Comment
Release Lock
